sentences.en: Could you send someone up to pick up some laundry?
sentences.zh: 你能派个人上来取一下洗衣吗？

sentences.en: I put the rest of your clothes in the laundry.
sentences.zh: 我把剩下的衣服都扔进了洗衣机。

sentences.en: Does anybody have any laundry they want me to do?
sentences.zh: 有人需要我帮忙洗衣服吗？

senses.zh: 洗衣店，洗衣房；要洗的衣服；洗熨；洗好的衣服
